landing.hero: From seasonal budget to bankable Business Plan — verifiable.
landing.sub: Vision One structures agricultural financial planning with deterministic calculations and a QR-verifiable PDF.
landing.step1Desc: Zone, capital, surface, orientation, risk appetite.
landing.step3Desc: Verifiable via QR code and SHA-256 fingerprint.
landing.refDesc: Dual provenance: real Bee One data (aggregated and anonymized) + expert committee. Every norm cites source, region, period, sample. Versioned, k-anonymous (≥ 5).
landing.refBeeOneDesc: Aggregated and anonymized from operational farms.
landing.refComDesc: Norm completeness and calibration by an independent panel.
landing.refVersionDesc: Every document cites the exact reference version used.
landing.pdfDesc: Every generated document carries a QR code linking to a public Vision One proof page. The SHA-256 fingerprint detects any tampering. Forced assumptions are listed publicly.
landing.pricingIntro: We charge for depth and traceability, not edits.
landing.planFreeDesc: Scored recommendation + normative margin per ha.
landing.planActDesc: Full campaign budget or full business plan.
landing.footerLegal: Vision One — Verifiable agricultural financial planning.
